name: Powerbuilding 4x/Week — Alternating Full Body / Push-Pull
description: 9-week wave-loaded program. Odd weeks = Full Body x4. Even weeks = Push/Pull x4. Deload week 5, taper week 9, optional max testing week 10.

exercises.name: Back Squat (Top Set)
exercises.coach_notes: Heaviest squat work of the week. Brace hard, own the descent, drive up with intent.

exercises.name: Back Squat (Backoff)
exercises.coach_notes: Same bar speed as the top set, just lighter — don't let form drift.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.coach_notes: Auto-calculated at ~55-65% of your DEADLIFT 1RM: an RDL max is typically ~80-85% of a conventional pull, so this puts sets of 8 at a moderate RPE. Adjust if it feels off.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.coach_notes: 30-45° incline, deep stretch at the bottom, don't flare excessively.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.coach_notes: Row to your lower ribs, pause and squeeze the shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
exercises.coach_notes: Superset: go straight from crunches into the knee raises with no rest.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.coach_notes: As many controlled reps as possible right after each crunch set. Rest after the pair.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press (Top Set)
exercises.coach_notes: Comfortable arch, controlled touch, explode off the chest.

exercises.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
exercises.coach_notes: Accessory pressing — controlled reps, stop 1-3 shy of failure.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust (Backoff)
exercises.coach_notes: Chin tucked, ribs down, hard 1-count squeeze at lockout.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.coach_notes: Full dead hang to chin over bar. Sub pulldown if needed.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pressdown
exercises.coach_notes: Elbows pinned, full lockout each rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.coach_notes: Lead with the elbows, control the negative.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Top Set)
exercises.coach_notes: Pull the slack out of the bar, brace, drive the floor away.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Backoff)
exercises.coach_notes: Touch and go — Light tap and go, no bouncing. Re-brace at the top of every rep.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.coach_notes: Rear foot elevated, most of the weight in the front leg — knee-dominant, easy on the low back.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pulldown
exercises.coach_notes: Pull your elbows down and back against your sides.

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.coach_notes: Dead-stop each rep — strict, no momentum.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.coach_notes: Full stretch at the bottom, pause hard at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust (Top Set)
exercises.coach_notes: Heaviest hip thrust work of the week. Drive through mid-foot, lock out hard.

exercises.name: Back Squat (Volume)
exercises.coach_notes: Controlled tempo, full depth, no grinders.

exercises.name: Strict Bench Press (Backoff)
exercises.coach_notes: Dead-stop 1-count pause on the chest every rep.

exercises.name: Helms Row
exercises.coach_notes: Alt: One-Arm DB Row. Easy on the lower back by design — stay strict.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.coach_notes: Big stretch behind the head, constant tension on the triceps.

exercises.name: Barbell (or EZ-Bar) Curl
exercises.coach_notes: Elbows pinned at your sides, no swinging.
